title: Your ping can never be zero. Here's the limit #Shorts

yt.title: Your ping can never be zero. Here's the limit #Shorts
yt.description:
Minimum round-trip time over 1,000 km of optical fiber, from the refractive index of glass (~1.47).
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: Your ping can never be zero
scenes.narration: Even with perfect internet, your ping can never be zero.
Inside fiber, light moves about {c_fkms_say} kilometers per second. A third slower than in space.

scenes.label: minimum ping, before any routing
scenes.narration: So a server one thousand kilometers away costs at least {c_ms_say} milliseconds.
Real cables zigzag, so real pings are higher.
How far away is your game server?
